recmod.tooltip.locked: Use your flash to learn more about this item.
recmod.tooltip.known: Press G to open the log.
recmod.codex.title: ITEM LOG
recmod.codex.battery.desc: An ordinary battery, the kind you used to buy anywhere. It recharges the camera and, along with it, whatever is left of you. Swapping a battery is the only known way to recover sanity.
recmod.codex.battery.obtain: Found in the chests of old structures and lying on the ground near you. It can also be built from 4 aluminum ingots, 2 gold ingots, glowstone dust and redstone.
recmod.codex.aluminum.desc: Light, soft and dull. It is good for exactly one thing: becoming the shell of a battery. Whoever finds an aluminum vein in a cave is a few steps away from never rationing power again.
recmod.codex.aluminum.obtain: Small veins in any overworld cave, between height -32 and 60. A stone pickaxe is enough. Smelt the raw ore into ingots.
recmod.codex.corrupted_stone.desc: Stone that stopped being stone. It sits colder than the rock around it, and the veins hold a light no mineral has any business holding. It grows in patches in the deep, always as if something underneath had leaked upward and the ground had gone along with it.
recmod.codex.corrupted_stone.obtain: Rare veins in deep caves, below height 40. A stone pickaxe is enough to break it.
recmod.codex.iron_stick.desc: Two bars beaten together until they held as one. It bends where wood would snap, and it carries weight wood could never carry. Everything in this workshop that needs a spine gets this one.
recmod.codex.iron_stick.obtain: Two iron ingots, one above the other.
recmod.codex.hammer.desc: A stone head on a wooden handle. It does exactly one thing, and it wears itself down doing it. No amount of care brings a spent hammer back: you make another one.
recmod.codex.hammer.obtain: Five cobblestone in a helmet shape with two sticks. To use it: hammer on the LEFT slot of an anvil, iron ingots on the right.
recmod.codex.pressed_iron.desc: Iron with the shape beaten out of it. The dents across the face are the tool's signature, and they are the reason no two plates look alike.
recmod.codex.pressed_iron.obtain: Anvil only, never a crafting table. Hammer on the left, iron ingots on the right; each plate costs one point of hammer.
recmod.codex.sharp_scissors.desc: Not the shears from the shed. These were built to take something off a body that had no intention of giving it up. Nothing in this world fits between the blades yet.
recmod.codex.sharp_scissors.obtain: Two pressed iron plates and two iron ingots, crossed.
recmod.codex.black_goo.desc: It is heavier than it looks and it never fully dries. Whatever the corruption is made of, this is what is left once you cook it out of the stone. It does not smell of anything, which is somehow worse.
recmod.codex.black_goo.obtain: Smelt corrupted stone in a furnace. Slow on purpose — there will be a faster way once the Extractor exists.
recmod.codex.corrupted_kit.desc: Stone that stopped being stone, wrapped around a tool that used to be yours. It swings faster and bites harder than diamond, but it will not break obsidian and it will not last. It is a trade, not an upgrade.
recmod.codex.corrupted_kit.obtain: Any diamond tool in the middle of the grid, four corrupted stone around it. Repairs with corrupted stone.
recmod.codex.corrupted_diamond_pickaxe.d: The corruption went into the diamond and the diamond let it in. It breaks anything this world has — and it is the only thing that will take a Tear of Reality off the wall it is hiding in.
recmod.codex.corrupted_diamond_pickaxe.o: A diamond pickaxe in the middle, four black goo in the corners, four emeralds on the sides. Repairs with black goo.
recmod.codex.corrupted_compass.desc: It does not spin. It writes. Hold it up and it tells you, in plain numbers, how far your bed is and which way it lies — and it is never wrong, which is the part that starts to bother you after a while.
recmod.codex.corrupted_compass.obtain: A compass in the middle of the grid, four corrupted stone around it. It is also the seed of larger instruments.
recmod.codex.anchor.desc: Four seconds standing perfectly still, and the world lets go of you. It will not save you from anything that is already running at you — that is the point. It is for the moment you realise how deep you went, while you are still alone down there.
recmod.codex.anchor.obtain: Three iron blocks on top, a corrupted compass between two black goo, three aluminum ingots at the bottom. Sleeps for five minutes after each use.
recmod.codex.lure_clock.desc: It rings where you point it, not where you stand — which is the only reason it is worth carrying. Anything within earshot forgets what it was doing and goes to look. Whatever hunts by sound will care about this far more than a zombie does.
recmod.codex.lure_clock.obtain: Four black goo and three iron rods around an aluminum ingot. Point at a spot up to 32 blocks away and use it.
recmod.ore_tracker.activated: The needle bites. Something valuable is near.
recmod.ore_tracker.hint: Hold use for the rite. Six minutes of red through stone.
recmod.structure_locator.empty: Nothing answers. No structure within reach.
recmod.structure_locator.hint: Hold use for the rite. Points to the nearest structure for six minutes.
recmod.tracker.interrupted: You broke the rite too soon.
recmod.codex.ore_tracker.desc: An ear pressed to the rock. Perform the rite and for six minutes the nearest vein of anything worth having glows red straight through the stone, and a heart beats faster the closer you get. Then it goes quiet, and you have to earn the sound again.
recmod.codex.ore_tracker.obtain: An ender pearl wrapped in black goo over three aluminum ingots, redstone on top. Hold down use to wake it.
recmod.codex.structure_locator.desc: The corrupted compass grown an eye. It does not read a bed anymore — it finds the nearest thing people built and hangs a red mark on the horizon for six minutes. The heart only starts once you are close.
recmod.codex.structure_locator.obtain: An eye of ender and a corrupted compass, black goo at the sides, aluminum below. Hold down use to fix on a signal.
recmod.codex.rf_receiver.desc: The bench where the signal is worked. A gutted television with a tuner bolted into it — you feed electronics in one side and pull something worse out the other. Everything past scrap metal is made here.
recmod.codex.rf_receiver.obtain: A glass front, circuit scrap and a busted tuner over an iron chassis and a workbench. Right-click to open it; it crafts by amount, not by shape.
recmod.codex.circuit_scrap.desc: A broken piece of a circuit board, green and gold and dead. The bones of every dead machine you smashed for it. Nothing works on its own — but nothing here gets built without it.
recmod.codex.circuit_scrap.obtain: Pried out of old monitors, TVs and radios in abandoned places. For now it also comes off the bench: copper, redstone and an iron nugget.
recmod.codex.magnetized_copper_tape.desc: Copper wound tight and charged until it holds a field. It remembers a signal the way tape remembers a picture — badly, and forever.
recmod.codex.magnetized_copper_tape.obta: A copper ingot, redstone and a sticky wad, worked together on a bench.
recmod.codex.blank_magnetic_tape.desc: An empty reel. Nothing on it yet — which is the point. Everything that records the signal starts here, waiting to be written over with something you would rather not see.
recmod.codex.blank_magnetic_tape.obtain: Magnetized copper tape wrapped around a sheet of film.
recmod.codex.static_residue.desc: The grain an anomaly leaves behind when it goes. It is not dust and it is not light; it sits on the floor and hums, and it fogs a jar the moment you scoop it.
recmod.codex.static_residue.obtain: Left in shimmering patches where anomalies manifest, gathered with a glass jar. Until then, a jar and gunpowder stand in for it.
recmod.codex.static_condenser.desc: Four handfuls of static pressed into one cell that will not stop buzzing. The first thing the bench makes, and the part inside almost everything it makes after.
recmod.codex.static_condenser.obtain: In the Frequency Receiver: four static residue, a blank magnetic tape and redstone.
recmod.codex.busted_tuner.desc: A pocket radio that took a fall. It cannot find a station anymore — but it finds the OTHER thing, the carrier under the silence, and it will not shut up about it.
recmod.codex.busted_tuner.obtain: Circuit scrap, an iron bar and a redstone repeater on a bench.
recmod.codex.crt_tube.desc: A clean cathode-ray tube, still clear, still cold. Glass and a filament and a held breath. It is what a screen is before a screen goes wrong.
recmod.codex.crt_tube.obtain: Glass panes around redstone over a circuit scrap. Later it comes off broken televisions.
recmod.codex.reinforced_syringe.desc: Thick vintage glass and an iron needle, built to draw something that would eat a plastic one. It is ready long before you are: it only pays off once the infection is deep enough to bleed.
recmod.codex.reinforced_syringe.obtain: Two glass blocks, an iron bar and an iron nugget for the needle.
recmod.codex.contaminated_blood.desc: Your own blood, drawn after the signal got into it. It is darker than it should be and it does not sit still in the glass. Half of what the bench builds at the top needs a little of you in it.
recmod.codex.contaminated_blood.obtain: Drawn from yourself with a reinforced syringe once the infection is past halfway. For now, a stand-in recipe fills the vial.
recmod.codex.corrupted_crt_tube.desc: A cathode tube with the sickness in it, glowing a purple that is not on any channel. The heart of the instruments that bend the picture — and the ones that let things through it.
recmod.codex.corrupted_crt_tube.obtain: In the Frequency Receiver: a clean CRT tube, a static condenser and a vial of contaminated blood.
recmod.tear.sense: You feel something that you don't understand.
recmod.fracture.second: The second cut holds. Something can pass now.
recmod.codex.reality_tear.desc: A shard of the place where the world stopped agreeing with itself. It is warm, it is bright, and it is the only thing you have ever held that does not seem to be entirely here.
recmod.codex.reality_tear.obtain: Deep in caves, hanging in open air, invisible. Take a photo near one and the flash will show it for a few seconds. Only a corrupted diamond pickaxe will take it off the wall.
recmod.codex.fracture.desc:
Two tears and an iron rod, and the blade came out humming. Cut once to open a door, cut again to open its twin, and anything that touches one comes out the other. Crouch and cut to close them both.

Whatever is chasing you can use the door too. That is not a flaw.
recmod.codex.fracture.obtain: A tear of reality above and below an iron rod. Cuts for 8 damage on its own.
recmod.codex.infrared_lens.desc: Green glass ground from corrupted goo. Hold it up and the things that hide from the eye stop hiding: the Tears of Reality light up while it is in your hand. It never turns off, which is why it drinks the battery twice as fast — seeing the invisible is not free.
recmod.codex.infrared_lens.obtain: Two glass panes and black goo in a cross, redstone on top, aluminum along the bottom. Just hold it — there is nothing to press.
recmod.codex.corrupted_battery.desc: A battery the goo got into. It fills the camera all the way in one use — more than a clean cell ever did — but it takes the difference out of your head instead of giving it back. Fine in a pinch; a habit that ends badly.
recmod.codex.corrupted_battery.obtain: A battery, black goo and corrupted stone on the bench, no shape needed. Use it like any battery.
recmod.codex.blank_tape.desc: An empty cassette. Use it and the camera records for a few seconds — but you cannot watch it now. That is the whole trick: you film an empty hallway and only find out later, somewhere safe, what walked through it behind you.
recmod.codex.blank_tape.obtain: Iron nuggets around a piece of redstone. Use it to start recording; watch it back in a videocassette.
recmod.codex.videocassette.desc: The deck that plays the tapes back. It records nothing itself — it only shows you what you already filmed, at the speed you filmed it. This is where the delay comes due.
recmod.codex.videocassette.obtain: An iron box with a glass face and redstone inside. Use it to open the vault of recorded tapes.
recmod.codex.tripod.desc: Plant it and it films for you. Stand near one and your own viewfinder goes dark — you are behind the camera now — and a small monitor lights up in the corner. It cannot see for you, but it will shout MOTION when something crosses its range.
recmod.codex.tripod.obtain: Five iron ingots in the shape of a camera on splayed legs. Place it on the ground and walk away.
recmod.codex.fracture_pickaxe.desc: The same light the sword is made of, hammered flat onto a forged iron haft. It bites through anything the game has, and it never stops moving in your hand.
recmod.codex.fracture_pickaxe.obtain: Three reality tears over two iron sticks. Repaired with another tear — nothing else takes.
recmod.codex.fracture_axe.desc: The tear folded into a wedge. It cuts wood the way it cuts everything else: without noticing.
recmod.codex.fracture_axe.obtain: Three reality tears and two iron sticks, in the shape of an axe.
recmod.codex.fracture_shovel.desc: A single tear on a haft. The smallest piece of the family, and still the fastest shovel there is.
recmod.codex.fracture_shovel.obtain: One reality tear over two iron sticks.
recmod.codex.fracture_suit.desc: Pressed iron holds the frame; the tear does the covering. It leaves your face open on purpose — a suit made of a hole in the world was never going to be a place to hide.
recmod.codex.fracture_suit.obtain: Reality tears and pressed iron. The whole set costs twelve tears; repaired with another tear.
recmod.difficulty.title: SELECT TAPE SPEED
recmod.difficulty.hint: The tape is already rolling. Pick one — there is no going back and re-recording the start.
recmod.difficulty.normal.desc: The tape holds. Sanity falls at the usual price, the battery lasts, and the picture only rots near the bottom.
recmod.difficulty.hard.desc: Looking costs more, the battery dies sooner, and the tape turns on you while the meter is still half full.
tooltip.recmod.dimension_tape: Put it in the player. Use it again to come back.
message.recmod.tape_dead: The tape spins on nothing. There is nothing recorded on it.
tooltip.recmod.caller: A bent antenna and a light that still comes on.
tooltip.recmod.caller_warning: Sneak and use to arm. There is no undoing this.
message.recmod.caller_armed: ARMED. Use again within 10 seconds to call. Day will not come back.
message.recmod.caller_arm_first: Sneak and use to arm it.
message.recmod.caller_fired: Someone called. The sky has cracked.
message.recmod.parkour_fell: You missed. The tape switched itself.
message.recmod.tape_one_way: The tape won't rewind here. There is another way out of this place.
message.recmod.mirror_broken: You looked. The mirror cracked and something shoved you.
message.recmod.track_door: Something opened on the tracks, further ahead.
message.recmod.mirror_turn_back: you need to turn back before it's too late
